description: The gate key `after-step1` of the 1.0.0 example is the gate of step1 (SPEC-2.0 §5.5, rc.8): its expression passes on exit 3, so the flow goes on to step2. A key that names no step of the flow (`decide`) is valid (the schema does not constrain the keys) and is not evaluated. rc.7: validate accepted the document and run refused it (code 2).
